title: Daily paid-order report
context: Operations reviewer preparing a USD report from a simple order export. This draft covers one fictional work session, not a verified company-wide standard. Proposed change: a second operator checks the exported totals.
origin: Curated synthetic candidate for learning the review flow

evidence.text: Export completed: orders.csv has order_id, customer, total, status. Amounts are USD.

Sum the paid amounts by customer. Calculate in cents and display two decimal places.
Save a separate paid-orders.csv and compare the totals with the source export. Do not overwrite orders.csv.
